# The pasted examples that ARE executed by a test through the comparator
# (onboarding.CompareTranscript, the one comparator of SPEC-TOOLWORK.md documents rule 2;
# or the older onboarding.Compare, directly or via onboarding.Execute, where a
# section is still on the transcripts allowlist), per SPEC-TOOLWORK.md documents rule 6. One per line: `<test file>:<TestName> <the $ line, exactly as pasted>`
# or `<test file>:<TestName> example: <a help banner's example line>`.
#
# TestPlatformsMatchCILegsAndUnexecutedExamplesOnlyShrink checks every entry: the example is a real pasted or help example;
# the named test is declared in a _test.go file of the example's tool's package;
# the test, or a test helper it calls, reaches the comparator; it carries the
# example's own command text (a string literal the example is, or begins with,
# naming at least the tool and its verb) or executes the tool's transcript of a
# doc it reads that holds the exact line; and it reads a doc the example is
# pasted in. An example is in this file or in unexecuted_examples.txt, never
# both. Moving a line from unexecuted_examples.txt to here is how that list
# shrinks.
